description.en: EditorJumper is a JetBrains IDE plugin that allows you to seamlessly jump between JetBrains IDE and other popular code editors (such as VS Code, Cursor, Trae, and Windsurf). It maintains your cursor position and editing context, greatly improving development efficiency in multi-editor environments.
description.zh: JetBrains插件，可在JetBrains IDE与VS Code、Cursor等编辑器间跳转并保持上下文。

usecases.zh: 在JetBrains IDE和其他编辑器间无缝跳转
usecases.en: Seamlessly jump between JetBrains IDE and other editors
